name: Ord Carpagia
description: Ord Carpagia was a world located in the Carpagia system, a part of the Northern Dependencies portion of the Colonies. It served as an Ordnance/Regional Depot outpost for the Galactic Republic during the Pius Dea Era, a period of time that lasted between approximately 12,000 BBY and 11,000 BBY.
